title: What have I done? This is not normal (maps)
author: johnesco
selftext:
I've been balancing adding new feature \*cough\* SCOPE CREEP \*cough\*, but had an idea I wanted to try. Probably would run at 10 fps but though it would be cool to look at. I wanted to add the following to my game...

While I already have normal maps for making the cars look nearly 3D and respond to light, I was like, what if I added it to the road itself?

Wow, it worked, but surely this won't run well on phones (wait it does!)

People ask, how can you learn things if AI is doing things for you. Just from being curious, I feel into a long rabbit hole of a not-so-new tech that is hyper efficient. I had no idea how beautify fast normal maps could be.

So what I added was, now instead of just tire marks on the roads, it alters the normal map and make it look like the cars leave 3D grooves in the road.

https://i.redd.it/sveeqmoind1i1.png

What have you experiment with, then learned more about and expanded your understanding?
